_about: List prices in USD for US East (N. Virginia), copied from the AWS Price List API (https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/<service>/current/us-east-1/index.json). Copied on 2026-10-19: AmazonECS 20260911124425 (Fargate ARM), AmazonStates 20260911124511 (Step Functions), AmazonSageMaker 20261016211645, AWSEvents 20260924163903 (EventBridge Scheduler), AmazonECR 20260911124425, AmazonSNS 20260915151944. Reused from chapter 2 (copied 2026-10-16 / 2026-10-13): AWSLambda 20261012223257, AmazonS3 20261012231102, AmazonAthena 20260911124408, AmazonDynamoDB 20260911124422, AmazonCloudWatch 20261007115540. Where a price has tiers, the tiers cost.py uses are listed; everything else is first tier. No free-tier allowance is applied anywhere except where a zero-price first tier is part of the list price itself (Scheduler, SNS). Re-check before quoting to anyone.
